01-motion.title: Move active entities
criteria: no per-entity GetRef/GetReadRef for known rows

02-nearest.title: Select one nearby living enemy
criteria: ordered First/min selection O(N), no full sort
no list+LINQ sorting or manual universal getters

03-budget.title: Spend a damage budget in distance order
criteria: direct ref Health, read-only ordering inputs
explicit mutable budget/context or reused closure
correct value predicate and membership filters

04-entity-output.title: Update health and return affected entity handles
criteria: no EntityRef.GetRef for Health passed by callback
output lifetime handles are Entity, not EntityRef
query membership rather than extra per-entity Has

05-configured-rows.title: Update registrations selected by configuration
criteria: typed float callback with explicit IDs/span
component-bearing ForEach, not zero-arity dynamic getters
read damage/write configured health access modes

07-tag-events.title: Report tag changes and writable tag access
criteria: tag tracking same API as data
no tag payload reads or independent mask/cache

08-runtime-dispatch.title: Reset one dynamically selected component
criteria: point GetRef<T> with membership guard is appropriate

09-world-snapshot.title: Save selected world state on every call
criteria: an equivalent retained runtime generic functor route is valid when it resolves the CLR type during preparation
retained one-component typed ForEachEntity(EntityRef, in T) operations
O(sum present instances), not O(group size * all entities) membership tests
no repeated Visit per save or entity
snapshot not replaced by change-only data
explicit IDs used for non-primary registrations

10-structural.title: Remove defeated enemies from the world
criteria: query membership + Where health predicate + Destroy terminal
no structural mutation inside active callback

11-entity-only.title: Collect entities selected only by membership
criteria: query membership only, no unnecessary typed rows

12-target-list.title: Apply a command to an existing target list
criteria: explicit entity-list component-bearing ForEach + optional query

13-group-cleanup.title: Remove components belonging to configured groups
criteria: type-erased batch Remove, no CLR type discovery needed
query targets current entities, not initial fixture handles
preserve primary float and unrelated registrations
